summary: The off-diagonal ordered-pair construction, metronoid realization, exact mass and moment identities, conditional-law interpretation, halfspace bound, conditioned covariance and affine-defect consequences, and cross-parity capacity counterexample all follow with the stated hypotheses and normalizations. The proof handles singleton, zero-output, boundary, vertical-halfspace, degenerate-halfspace, and singular-covariance cases without a gap.
